correctness.rationale: Identify Cent(J_m⊕J_m)=M_2(F_q[t]/t^m), preserving base-field rank as image length. Primitive square-zero matrices are GL2(chain ring) conjugate to E12 via Nakayama, count (q²-1)q^{2ell-2}. Valuation layers a<ceil(m/2) each have (q²-1)q^{2m-2} members; determinant uniformity and Smith exponents yield every rank coefficient, with automatic-square-zero high-valuation cone giving P_ell terms. Summing gives h(q²-1)q^{2m-2}+q^{4floor(m/2)} and maximal-rank count (q²-1)q^{2m-3}(q+floor(m/2)(q-1)). Field q=2,3,4 and odd m boundaries treated; all finite fields. Independently compared each coefficient with the earlier chain-ring full rank polynomial for 44 (q,m) choices, q=2,3,4,5 and m=1..11; all match. The all-m proof is the valuation and Smith argument, not these finite examples.
